title: Enum classification marker
question: How is the closed/open classification of every published enum expressed in code? knowledge/contracts#markers gives Api only a since argument and no ecosystem package classifies enums.

options.text: PHPDoc tag in the enum docblock: exactly one of @closed or @open; the manifest generator records it; a test requires it on every attributed enum and compares it with the type-map enum column
New attribute argument #[Api(since, enum: EnumKind)] plus a new Attributes\EnumKind type (contract amendment)
Classification only in the manifest, read from the target-map oracle; no marker in the source

context: Gap found in the P2 design session: architecture#api-compatibility requires closed/open enums and the generator must record them, but no mechanism is fixed. Owner answer M14.
decision: A — PHPDoc tag in the enum docblock: exactly one of @closed or @open; the manifest generator records it; a test requires it on every attributed enum and compares it with the type-map enum column
rationale: Owner chose the PHPDoc tag (M14): no change to the Api/Spi signatures, machine-readable by the generator and checkable against the oracle.
consequences: P2.1 adds the tag to every attributed enum from the type-map enum column; the generator writes an `enum` field (closed|open) per enum entry.
Adding a case to a @closed enum is a major change after 1.0 (D9).
